credit_metrics.text: Revenue rose by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}}, and EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, lifting the EBITDA margin by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}.

Interest coverage improved by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, and FFO rose by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}, taking FFO to debt up by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity rose by {{liquidity.change@FY2024}} to {{liquidity@FY2024}}, of which {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}} in undrawn committed facilities, down by {{undrawn_facilities.change@FY2024}}.

Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue up by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

The fleet grew by {{fleet.change@FY2024}} to {{fleet@FY2024}} aircraft, with an average age of {{fleet_age@FY2024}}, as engine reliability issues and delivery delays continued to affect the group.

snapshot.text: International Airlines Group, the owner of British Airways, Iberia, Aer Lingus and Vueling, ended FY2024 with a stronger credit profile, and both Moody's and S&P upgraded the group to investment grade during the year.
Net leverage fell by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}} as EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}.

The point to watch is customer prepayments: advance ticket cover fell by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, the weakest of the network peers ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@2024}}).

watch_items.text: Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@2024}} but the weakest of the group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@2024}}), a sensitivity if bookings slow.

Committed facilities: undrawn committed facilities fell by {{undrawn_facilities.change@FY2024}} to {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}}, so the buffer outside cash is smaller.
